_meta.description: Matched-pair arm corpus for the Q3 2026 cut. 16 templates = 8 harm domains x 2 registers. Each template is rendered into three arms that differ in exactly one contiguous span: the noun phrase naming who made the decision.
_meta.why_16: Not negotiable downward. A prior single-template substitution pass was killed in adversarial review at n_templates=1 (results/THE-WASH-2026-06-10.md:115); the remedy adjudicated there was 16 templates. Fewer re-opens a settled question.
_meta.why_three_arms: Two arms (algorithm vs person) cannot separate 'defers about AI' from 'defers about impersonal bureaucratic process'. The institution arm is the discriminator: algorithm != person while algorithm ~= institution means generic institutional deference and the thesis fails; algorithm != person AND algorithm != institution means it holds; all three alike is a publishable null.
_meta.noun_rotation: noun_index = domain_index % 3, so the noun is crossed with the domain rather than nested. One noun per arm would confound the arm with whatever that phrase evokes.
_meta.rubric: The FROZEN v2 1-5 rubric, unchanged. The estimand is a within-pair difference under one rubric, so a constant offset between the rubric's institution axis and these questions' culpability axis cancels exactly. The cluster needs the same rubric applied to all three arms, not a rubric calibrated in absolute terms.
_meta.level_warning: Matched-pair scores are NOT comparable in level to the main study's 1-5 scores. Only arm differences are the product. scripts/paired_analysis.py prints this with every result.
_meta.estimator: scripts/paired_analysis.py — cluster bootstrap with the TEMPLATE as the cluster, exact sign test, BH-FDR over three pre-registered contrasts. Do NOT analyse these with ci_analysis.py, whose flat i.i.d. bootstrap treats samples of one template as independent.
_meta.control: Mismatched-stem calibration, pre-registered before anyone looks: 48 responses re-scored under a different arm's stem with the response text byte-identical, measuring pure judge stem effect. ABORT RULE, fixed in advance: if the stem-effect CI overlaps the arm-gap estimate, the cut reports 'not separable at this n' and makes no substantive claim.
_meta.power: 16 templates x 3 arms x 2 samples x 7 models = 1,344 calls, pooled n=224 per (arm, condition), which clears the pre-registered n>=200. Per-model cells are n=32 and are PERMANENTLY EXPLORATORY: at 32 per quarter, promising they reach 200 is seven quarters, which is not a plan. Q3 is cut 1 of a quarterly accumulation.
